contentBlocks.body: A rest parameter, written ...numbers, gathers any number of trailing arguments into a real array. The function can then loop or reduce over them, so callers are not limited to a fixed argument count.

payload.text: Writing function f(...args) collects the arguments into an array using the ____ parameter syntax.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Using a rest parameter, return the sum of all numbers passed in (0 when none are passed).
